'''Corkscrew''' is a computer program, written by Patrick Padgett, that enables the user to tunnel [[SSH]] connections through most [[HTTP]] and [[HTTPS]] [[proxy server]]s.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Danen |first=Vincent |date=2009-10-05 |title=Using Corkscrew to tunnel SSH over HTTP |url=https://www.techrepublic.com/article/using-corkscrew-to-tunnel-ssh-over-http/ |access-date=2024-02-04 |website=[[TechRepublic]] |language=en-US}}</ref> Combined with features of [[Secure Shell|SSH]] such as [[port forwarding]], this can allow many types of services to be run securely over the SSH via HTTP connections.

Supported proxy servers:
* [[Gauntlet (proxy server)|Gauntlet]]
* [[CacheFlow]]
* [[Internet Junkbuster]]
* [[Squid (software)|Squid]]
* Apache's [[mod_proxy]]
